cases.description: engine/response_builder.py is stack-trace-confirmed (score 118, tier stack-trace) — the traceback names build_response directly, the highest-confidence tier, well above the two keyword-only endpoint candidates.

response_builder.py has fan_in=14 and is a flagged hotspot — every API endpoint depends on it, so a fix to build_response (e.g. always populating request_id) must be tested against multiple endpoints, not just the one that surfaced the bug report, and should ideally add a regression test asserting the field is always present.

Because request_id is 'missing on some responses' (intermittent, not every response), the bug is likely conditional inside build_response (e.g. only populated on one code path) rather than a total omission — worth checking all call sites/branches within this one hotspot module before assuming a caller-side issue.
